name: Coffee C
read: Coffee C Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 276, 83 days to expiry 2027-02-10): at-the-money implied vol 36.7%, +0.9 pts vs 2026-11-13. 20-day realized vol 25.4%, so options trade at a premium of 11.3 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +2.2 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-11-06 to 2026-11-19) call open interest fell 36,964 and puts fell 71,125; put/call OI 1.39 → 1.13, front futures 271.65 → 276. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +3,931 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 38.5% → 36.7%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 300 calls (2,856 lots) and 250 puts (5,300). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 250 puts +1,106; Mar 27 175 puts +909. Biggest cut: Mar 27 200 puts -764.
